about: fail_kind@1 regex layer. expect.labels is a subset match; every returned labels object is also validated against the schema. Cue order is crash, tests, merge, build, gaveup, loop, revert, timeout, lint, scope, permission, clarify, missing.

cases.name: tests: N failed
tests: 0 failed is a green summary
tests: FAILED line names the file
tests: the bare word assertion is not a failure

turns.text: I added an assertion to the helper.

cases.name: build: error CS code
build: the word error alone is not a build cue

turns.text: error handling is fine as it is

cases.name: gaveup: could not ... run it manually

turns.text: I couldn't get the linker to cooperate, please run it manually.

cases.name: gaveup: I can is not I cannot

turns.text: I can run the tests now.

cases.name: loop: three retries in the tail

turns.text: Let me try again. Hmm. let me try again. A different approach then.

cases.name: loop: two retries is not a loop

turns.text: Let me try again. Still no. Let me try again.

cases.name: revert: git checkout -- file

turns.text: That broke more. Running git checkout -- src/a.rs

cases.name: revert: committing is not reverting

turns.text: I will commit this change now.

cases.name: timeout: timed out with seconds
timeout: timeline is not a timeout
merge: conflict markers
merge: four angle brackets are not a marker
lint: N problems
lint: no problems found
crash: python traceback

input.tool_out:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "a.py", line 3, in <module>
ValueError: x

cases.name: crash: rust panic
crash: lowercase traceback mid-line is prose

turns.text: the traceback of this idea is short

cases.name: scope: while I was at it

turns.text: Done. While I was at it I renamed util.rs.

cases.name: scope: also without I is not the cue

turns.text: We might do this also later.

cases.name: permission: permission denied
permission: permissions model is prose
clarify: could you clarify

turns.text: Could you clarify which config you want?

cases.name: clarify: I clarified is past tense
missing: ENOENT names the file

input.tool_out: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'a.json'

cases.name: missing: the file exists

turns.text: the file exists and is readable
